g.text: Sequence Diagram: Dual-Layer Automated Trade Expiry (Deutsche Bank Trade Store)
Layer 1: Proactive Background Auto-Expiry Job (Every N Seconds/Minutes)
Layer 2: Read-Time Dynamic Fallback (Zero Stale Data Window)
Guarantees that even if the background cron hasn't executed yet,
a client reading a trade whose maturity date has passed NEVER receives expired='N'.
UPDATE trades SET expired = 'Y' WHERE trade_id = :id
HTTP 200 OK (Trade with guaranteed accurate expired='Y')
